scripts.ci:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security:secrets
scripts.infra:up: pnpm infra:setup && docker compose --project-directory infra/supabase --env-file infra/supabase/.env -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --project-directory infra/supabase --env-file infra/supabase/.env -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.infra:status: docker compose --project-directory infra/supabase --env-file infra/supabase/.env -f infra/supabase/docker-compose.yml ps
